A '''vibrobayonet''' was an advanced version of the [[Bayonet/Legends|bayonet]]. It consisted of a [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblade]] that attached to the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]] of a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] or other [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]], thus turning into a powerful [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]]. A vibrobayonet detached from a rifle could be used as a [[Vibrodagger/Legends|vibrodagger]].<ref name="SECR" />

==Users==
Many elite [[Commando/Legends|commando]] units routinely carried blaster rifles paired with a vibrobayonet,<ref name="TOTG">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> such as [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] commandos.<ref name="EGWT" /> The [[Mandalorian Supercommando]]es carried a [[Light repeating blaster/Legends|light repeating blaster]] with a vibrobayonet attachment,<ref name="TOTG" /> and the [[Taloron Hunters]] routinely carried a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] with a vibrobayonet.<ref name="SWSB">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref> Other known users of vibrobayonets included [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]],<ref name="GOA 23">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref> and the Rebel Alliance guerrilla fighter [[Biv Bodhrik/Legends|Biv Bodhrik]].<ref name="Twin Shadows">{{SWIA|set=Twin Shadows}}</ref> Vibrobayonets were often used as back-up weapons.<ref name="EGWT" />
